review.notes: User explicitly requests resumable action history and HQ-selected models. Review before new test implementation. No independent review or commit-order claim. Preserve existing no-subagent/no-live-input boundary during tests; actual model execution is a future authorized HQ action. User selected existing CLI reuse with HQ model choice. New cases cover evidence allowlist, explicit defer, shared lifetime token thresholds and unresolved attempts across runs; tests use fake processes only.

cases.setup: Synthetic KB and disposable HOME; fake provider only.
cases.action: Create a two-item frozen packet in a disposable HOME; interrupt after a persisted first result and one reservation. Reopen and resume with another explicit HQ model choice.
cases.expected: Completed items are not called again; interrupted item remains identifiable; model choices, input revisions, visible results, reasons, times and costs stay in durable sequence; no ledger/hit mutation.

cases.description: Concurrent runners and stale/private inputs are refused
cases.setup: Synthetic KB and disposable HOME; fake provider only.
cases.action: Run competing synthetic executors, corrupt/truncate the journal, change or retire an input, or make it sensitive before execution. Reject fabricated evidence; explicitly defer a failed pending item with a reason while retaining its history.
cases.expected: Only one runner obtains the stable lock; no call on corruption/stale/private input; status reads create nothing; no retry erases earlier charges or history.

cases.description: Shared cost reservations and bounded attempts
cases.setup: Synthetic KB and disposable HOME; fake provider only.
cases.action: Synthetic usage success/unknown/over-limit and interrupted requests; multiple runs share the journal.
cases.expected: Reserve before generation; completed usage reconciles once; interrupted or unknown charges never reset; stop at limits or errors without applying KB proposals. Pilot/bootstrap stop thresholds are shared across runs over their lifetime, not reset weekly; unresolved attempts block other runs. Unknown usage is not zero.

cases.description: Explicit model selection and bounded model process/protocol
cases.setup: Synthetic KB and disposable HOME; fake provider only.
cases.action: Fake process or in-memory HTTP transport only. No credentials or real model/window invocation.
cases.expected: Forward exact HQ model/reason; bounded timeout/output; strict final JSON, usage provenance and cancellation; secrets/raw private session URLs never logged.
